messages:
alex: Quick postmortem follow-up from yesterday's outage — we need to lock owners & ticketize remediations. I'll propose owners and deadlines below.

alex: TL;DR: recurring memory spike on gen-serve pool, cache eviction mismatch, and unclear oncall handoff during the P0 window.

maya: thanks alex. can you add the jira IDs when you create the tickets? easier to track in the PM tracker.

alex: yep. proposed list: 1) Investigate KV cache eviction policy mismatch (owner: @maya) — ticket RDX-6723 — due EOW 2026-03-27. 2) Add a safepath fallback to model variants under memory pressure (owner: @sam) — ticket RDX-6724 — due 2026-04-03. 3) Handoff/playbook gap for night oncall (owner: @jordan) — ticket RDX-6725 — due 2026-03-30. 4) Postmortem cleanups: add long-running evals to detect regressions (owner: @kelly) — ticket RDX-6726 — due 2026-04-10.

jordan: I can own the oncall playbook update. will add the explicit step: if a spike hits >80% mem for 2 minutes, escalate to SRE lead and switch routing to warm standby.

sam: noted on RDX-6724. question: do we prefer a quantized model fallback or a shorter-context variant? leaning toward shorter-context for safety.

maya: RDX-6723 acked. i'll instrument eviction metrics (per-model kv size) and add a dashboard tile. i'll also add a regression alert for sudden increase in evictions.

alex: RACI quick map: R = owner listed above, A = eng-sre (for deployment + rollout), C = product (for customer impact comms), I = postmortem author + oncall.

kelly: RDX-6726 — will work with research to add the evals. can we scope an initial smoke set (5 prompts) and a nightly run?

alex: yes smoke set first; nightlies later. kelly, add scope to the ticket and tag @research.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Created RDX-6723, RDX-6724, RDX-6725, RDX-6726 in backlog — links: https://jira.redwood/r/RDX-6723, https://jira.redwood/r/RDX-6724, https://jira.redwood/r/RDX-6725, https://jira.redwood/r/RDX-6726 :white_check_mark:

sam: created a short doc in /docs/runbooks/oncall-handoff.md and linked it in RDX-6725. pinging @jordan for review.

jordan: reviewing now. small nit: include timezone conversions and explicit handover checklist (incidents open, recent deploys, hotfixes applied).

alex: owners — please comment on your ticket with acceptance criteria and a one-line ETA. i'll collate and update the remediation matrix by EOD.

maya: acceptance: dashboard + alert + unit test that simulates eviction pattern. ETA EOW.

sam: acceptance: fallback route + canary test that triggers fallback. ETA 2026-04-03.

jordan: acceptance: updated playbook + 2 runbook drills with oncall. ETA 2026-03-30.

kelly: acceptance: smoke evals added to CI with nightly runs. ETA 2026-04-10.

alex: thanks all. i'll set a follow-up check-in next Wednesday 11am PT and mark the postmortem as "action items in progress". if anything slips, we escalate to the incident captain channel. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks — will update RDX tickets as PRs land.

maya: adding a recurring retro item to monthly postmortem review to watch for repeat spikes — better to catch patterns.

alex: good call. added to agenda. closing thread for now — reopen when new blockers appear. :white_check_mark:
